Our mission

Our business is to promote optimal health to individuals and to the community, with care that is available and accessible to all.

The oldest, most established physical therapy clinic in the Vail Valley, caring for residents and visitors.

  • Back Injuries/Pain

    Each patient receives a unique treatment plan integrating clinical expertise and research.

Meet the team

Experienced, compassionate professionals

Owner

Jennifer Martin

PT, DPT, OCS, FAAOMPT

Jennifer has dedicated herself to outpatient orthopedic and sports medicine physical therapy for over 25 years, with a focus on manual orthopedic care and helping patients return to their favorite activities. Taking over Vail Physical Therapy is coming full circle: it was her first physical therapy job out of PT school.

She has had the opportunity to treat and train professional athletes and performers, but is most fulfilled keeping individuals in her community active and healthy.

Board Certified Orthopedic SpecialistFellow, AAOMPTTrigger Point Dry NeedlingPilates RehabilitationAPTA member

David Cimino

PT, DPT, SCS, CSCS

A Sports Clinical Specialist and Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist. ImPACT-trained in post-concussive syndrome, with Functional Dry Needling, vestibular rehabilitation and pre/post-operative rehabilitation.

Tina Zoller

PT, DPT

Specializes in manual therapy with skilled soft tissue and sport and rehab exercise guidance. Practicing for over 15 years, 12 of those in the Vail Valley.

Stacey Matzke

Office Manager

The face and voice of the front office. A fourth-generation Colorado native, dedicated to the care of mountain residents.

New patients

Getting started is simple

01

Call to schedule

When you call, we gather your details and help schedule you with a provider.

02

Complete your patient portal

We send a secure email from OptimisPT so you can share your health history, surgeries and medications before you arrive.

03

Arrive ready

Three emails lead up to your first visit: the portal invitation, your insurance and ID card upload, and directions. Plus a reminder 24 hours before.
